title: Hygiene visit where the patient shares sensitive personal news

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: Sorry if I'm distracted, my divorce was finalized this week.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, that's a lot. Take your time.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: It's okay. I haven't been flossing much through all of it.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Understood. There's generalized gingivitis, the gums are puffy and bleeding.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: No decay. Let's see you back in three months to check the gums.
